instruction: I want to buy everything in my amazon cart. I have a promo code applied to the cart, but today I received a new promotional email from Amazon. See if it is a better deal. Place an order for my workplace delivery with whichever option is cheaper.
notes: The runtime branch (which promo code is cheaper) is encoded with a third promo-code object promo-best whose value is decided by the agent after comparing the cart totals under the old and the new code. amazon-show-cart reveals knowledge depending on the applied code: with promo-old applied it reveals the old code and its total; with promo-new applied (only possible after the old total is known, since apply requires cart-total-known of the currently applied code) it reveals promo-best. The final apply of promo-best is idempotent if the new code was already the cheaper one (re-applying the same code just sets it again); if the environment rejects re-application the agent may skip that call. apply_promo_code_to_cart is assumed to replace the currently applied code; if a removal were needed, amazon.remove_promo_code_from_cart would be inserted before applying. place_order must use the workplace address and any payment card, with no gift wrapping; the gmail/file_system changes listed in the evaluation are side effects of the order confirmation email and receipt generated by place_order. The goal (order-placed) is only reachable via a place-order whose preconditions enforce the workplace address and the cheapest promo code; supervisor-complete-task is last and takes no answer.
